objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled document subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving with versioning and status management

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document identifier prefix assigned to the document

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The substantive material and information contained in the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment subject to release cycle that automatically releases with the main document and triggers new version on modification

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment in the release process

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to release cycle that can be published directly without creating new main document version

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of additional information

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document managed without affecting content or version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State indicating whether the proposal is pending or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend document validity triggered 30 days before validity expiration

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and reactivate a previously invalidated document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person performing roles in the document management system

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned responsibility such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Reader

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with assigned permissions and responsibilities

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of user group such as Reader group or Archive group

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A collection of users and user groups assigned to receive document notifications or acknowledgements

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Purpose of distribution such as email notification or acknowledgement

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object with selection of document type and optional template

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Optional template selected for the document

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using an editing client that converts to PDF upon saving

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Entry and update of document properties, attributes and metadata organized by categories

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment of a controlled document supplement to a main document

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of a non-controlled supplement to provide further context or details about a document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and change rights to users and user groups for documents and related objects

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Type of permission such as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, or releaser

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Initiation of a proposed amendment to an existing document by authorized users

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Submission of a document to assigned reviewers for technical and formal checking

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal examination of document content by assigned reviewers

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Category of review such as technical or formal

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participants to document or request

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document making it visible to assigned readers

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of document authorizations and storage during archive period

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Length of time document remains archived before physical deletion

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration that a document remains valid for an additional period without revision

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Duration for which extended validity is granted

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration that a document is withdrawn from circulation and archived due to loss of validity

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation and restoration of a previously invalidated document to active status

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notification of assigned users and user groups via email when new document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Solicitation of active confirmation from assigned users and user groups upon document release

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by a user of receipt and understanding of a document

o2o.description: Main document has related controlled attachments that are released together
Document has supplementary additional information not subject to release cycle
Document has proposed amendments that may be implemented in future versions
Document can reference other documents via document properties

o2e.description: A document is created as a new information object
Document content is modified through editing
Document properties and metadata are maintained
An attachment is added to a document
Additional information is added to a document
Authorization rights are assigned for a document
A change proposal is created for a document
A document is submitted for review by reviewers
A document undergoes technical and formal review
A document is signed electronically by participants
A document is approved and released for distribution
A document is archived due to invalidity
A validity extension request is processed to extend document validity
An override request results in document invalidation
A reactivation request results in document re-validation
A document is translated into another language
User groups on distribution list receive email notification of new document versions
User groups on distribution list are requested to acknowledge receipt of document
A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document
